ogc_scope: Merged PR4936 full-surface edge-force rule, Eq14; not every part of OGC
kinematic_limit: Prescribed kinematic hands move outside DAT truncation
comparison_limit: Compare the recorded physics and Warp pins; this is not an isolated DAT ablation

runtime_configuration.mesh_contact_filter: Merged upstream OGC Eq. 14 wireframe edge-edge filtering; native full-surface solver selects force rows
runtime_configuration.motion_bridge: Copy prescribed state_out(t+dt) kinematic endpoints into state_in before native step
runtime_configuration.history_scope: Native first/reset step rebaselines at its input endpoint; later steps retain prior accepted pose
runtime_configuration.guarantee_scope: Kinematic motion is not DAT-truncated; no continuous prescribed-hand sweep guarantee
runtime_configuration.contact_latch_scope: Global rigid/full-surface counts at every owned detection, including preparation
runtime_configuration.self_contact_latch_scope: Raw vertex/edge/optional triangle row counts and capacity excess at every native self detection; sticky across preparation
runtime_configuration.capacity_scope_limit: Per-body adjacency and other internal broad/narrow-phase scratch capacities are not latched

dat_contact_coverage.scope: Sticky global rigid/full-surface and soft-self row counts across every owned detection, including preparation; excludes per-body adjacency capacities. Self-contact order: vertex-triangle, edge-edge, triangle-vertex.
